citation: I. P. Zibrov, V. P. Filonenko, M. Sundberg and P.-E. Werner (2000). Structures and phase transitions of B-Ta2O5 and Z-Ta2O5: two high-pressure forms of Ta2O5. Acta Crystallographica Section B 56, 659–665.

experiment.method: X-ray powder diffraction, Rietveld refinement; HRTEM phase/intergrowth characterization
experiment.pressure_note: Measurement pressure is not explicitly recorded in CIF. Do not substitute synthesis pressure.
experiment.phase_sample_note: The experiment found both B and Z phases; HRTEM described defect-rich B crystals and B/Z intergrowth.

occupancy.cod_curation_note: COD depositor comment: corrected occupancies on 25 February 2014. Original malformed occupancy values (multiplicities) remain in _atom_site_occupancy_[sic]; the valid _atom_site_occupancy values are all 1. No occupancy edits by this pilot.

site_model_note: Use the one independent Ta site; multiplicity is not an extra FEFF amplitude multiplier.
limits: High-pressure-synthesized polymorph, not an ambient L-Ta2O5 phase assignment.
Ordered average crystal model does not reproduce observed defects/intergrowth.
Oxygen coordinates have relatively large uncertainties in this powder refinement; preserve source coordinates.
